# Survey

> Survey is a PDF markup and counting app for construction and engineering drawings. It runs in the browser on Mac, Windows, iPad, Android tablets and phones at https://surveytool.app.

People use Survey to redline drawing sets, tap to count items on a plan (each category keeps a running total), and export the counts to Excel. Free plan: 1 project, 5 documents, 100MB. Pro: $9.99 a month or $99 a year, unlimited projects and documents, 10GB, survey tools, templates and regions, Excel export, OneDrive. Enterprise: $20 per user a month, minimum 3 users, live editing together, 1TB, admin tools and single sign-on.

## Pages

- [Home](https://surveytool.app/welcome): what Survey is and who it is for
- [Features](https://surveytool.app/features): count markers, pen and highlighter, shapes, clouds and arrows, large drawing sets
- [Devices](https://surveytool.app/devices): desktop, tablet and phone
- [Pricing](https://surveytool.app/pricing): Free, Pro and Enterprise plans
- [FAQ](https://surveytool.app/faq): common questions
- [Field surveys](https://surveytool.app/use-cases/field-surveys): Walk a site with the plans on your iPad, count what is there, tag what needs work and send the totals to Excel.
- [Punch lists](https://surveytool.app/use-cases/punch-lists): Mark punch items right on the floor plan with numbered markers and notes, then share the marked-up set with your team.
- [As-builts](https://surveytool.app/use-cases/as-builts): Red-line the drawings with what was really built: moved walls, rerouted runs, added fixtures. Keep it with the project.
- [Survey vs Bluebeam Revu](https://surveytool.app/compare/bluebeam): An honest look at Survey and Bluebeam Revu for marking up and counting on construction drawings: what each does best and who each one fits.
- [Survey vs Drawboard Projects](https://surveytool.app/compare/drawboard): An honest look at Survey and Drawboard Projects for marking up construction drawings: what each does best and who each one fits.
- [Free PDF tools](https://surveytool.app/tools): 42 tools to merge, split, compress, OCR scans, compare two PDFs, sign, lock and convert PDFs in the browser, several files at once; no sign-in, files never leave the device
- [Merge PDF](https://surveytool.app/tools/merge-pdf): Combine several PDFs into one file.
- [Split PDF](https://surveytool.app/tools/split-pdf): Break one PDF into several files.
- [Compress PDF](https://surveytool.app/tools/compress-pdf): Make a PDF smaller to email or upload.
- [Rotate PDF](https://surveytool.app/tools/rotate-pdf): Turn some or all pages the right way up.
- [Organize pages](https://surveytool.app/tools/organize-pdf): Reorder, turn and remove pages in one go.
- [Delete pages](https://surveytool.app/tools/delete-pages): Take pages out of a PDF.
- [Extract pages](https://surveytool.app/tools/extract-pages): Save chosen pages as a new PDF.
- [JPG to PDF](https://surveytool.app/tools/jpg-to-pdf): Turn photos into one PDF.
- [PNG to PDF](https://surveytool.app/tools/png-to-pdf): Turn PNG images into a PDF.
- [Image to PDF](https://surveytool.app/tools/image-to-pdf): WebP, GIF, BMP, TIFF, JPG or PNG to PDF.
- [Text to PDF](https://surveytool.app/tools/txt-to-pdf): Turn a .txt file into a clean PDF.
- [PDF to JPG](https://surveytool.app/tools/pdf-to-jpg): Save each page as a JPG image.
- [PDF to PNG](https://surveytool.app/tools/pdf-to-png): Save each page as a sharp PNG.
- [PDF to text](https://surveytool.app/tools/pdf-to-txt): Copy all the words out of a PDF.
- [Add page numbers](https://surveytool.app/tools/add-page-numbers): Number the pages of a PDF.
- [Add watermark](https://surveytool.app/tools/watermark-pdf): Stamp text like DRAFT across pages.
- [Headers and footers](https://surveytool.app/tools/add-header-footer): Add a line of text to the top or bottom of every page.
- [Flatten PDF](https://surveytool.app/tools/flatten-pdf): Lock markups and form answers into the page.
- [Crop PDF](https://surveytool.app/tools/crop-pdf): Trim the white edges off every page.
- [Edit PDF details](https://surveytool.app/tools/edit-pdf-details): Change the title, author and keywords.
- [Remove markups](https://surveytool.app/tools/remove-annotations): Strip comments and markups off a PDF.
- [Word to PDF](https://surveytool.app/tools/word-to-pdf): Turn a Word .docx file into a PDF.
- [TIFF to PDF](https://surveytool.app/tools/tiff-to-pdf): Turn TIFF scans and faxes into a PDF.
- [Sign PDF](https://surveytool.app/tools/sign-pdf): Draw or type your signature onto a PDF.
- [Protect PDF](https://surveytool.app/tools/protect-pdf): Lock a PDF with a password.
- [Unlock PDF](https://surveytool.app/tools/unlock-pdf): Take the password off a PDF you can open.
- [OCR PDF](https://surveytool.app/tools/ocr-pdf): Make a scanned PDF searchable.
- [Compare PDFs](https://surveytool.app/tools/compare-pdf): See what changed between two versions of a PDF.
- [Resize PDF pages](https://surveytool.app/tools/resize-pdf): Change the page size to Letter, A4, A3 or ARCH D.
- [Pages per sheet](https://surveytool.app/tools/n-up-pdf): Put 2, 4, 6 or 9 pages on one sheet.
- [Make a booklet](https://surveytool.app/tools/booklet-pdf): Print a PDF as a folded, stapled booklet.
- [Reverse PDF](https://surveytool.app/tools/reverse-pdf): Flip the page order so the last page comes first.
- [Insert blank pages](https://surveytool.app/tools/add-blank-pages): Add empty pages after every page or where you choose.
- [Repair PDF](https://surveytool.app/tools/repair-pdf): Fix a PDF that won't open or shows errors.
- [Split by bookmarks](https://surveytool.app/tools/split-by-bookmarks): One PDF per chapter or sheet, from its bookmarks.
- [Remove hidden data](https://surveytool.app/tools/sanitize-pdf): Strip metadata, scripts and attachments from a PDF.
- [Fast web view](https://surveytool.app/tools/fast-web-view): Make a big PDF open fast online, page 1 first.
- [Extract images](https://surveytool.app/tools/extract-images): Save every picture inside a PDF.
- [Remove blank pages](https://surveytool.app/tools/remove-blank-pages): Find empty pages and take them out.
- [PDF to TIFF](https://surveytool.app/tools/pdf-to-tiff): Save a PDF as one multi-page TIFF.
- [PDF to BMP](https://surveytool.app/tools/pdf-to-bmp): Save each page as a BMP picture.
- [Grayscale PDF](https://surveytool.app/tools/grayscale-pdf): Make a PDF black and white.
